verdict.rationale: First-party marketing docs state that llamafile 'Supports GGUF models including Llama, Mistral, Gemma, and Phi'. The docs also describe bundling model weights into a llamafile and running it, for example via --cli. However, the pack never shows a power-user loading an arbitrary standalone GGUF file at runtime (e.g., a model-path flag), so only the bundled/pre-built path is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented runtime loading of external GGUF files outside a bundled llamafile, detail on supported GGUF quantization types, and independent hands-on corroboration of GGUF loading.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can load and run models packaged in the GGUF format

citations.quote: Supports GGUF models including Llama, Mistral, Gemma, and Phi.
A llamafile bundles the llamafile executable, model weights, and a set of default arguments into a single self-contained file
If you add the `--cli` argument to a llamafile, you will run a CLI version of the model that answers to whatever you provide as a prompt
